title: Avel
html:
Avel is the son of Regelia and Chronoron and younger brother of Kripke and Pavel. Avel is a calculating, realistic manipulator with naval talents and lifestyle. He and Gattler command both the Yander Navy and the merchant fleets which cover a thousand different Shadow oceans in their trade. Avel seemed to give Pavel the sea passage to Yander on his first assault, but then ambushed him with help from Kripke, who was controlling the weather. After Kripke's death and Pavel's assumption of power, Avel faked his own death in order to "go underground" in finding the author of the threat to Yander among the Royal Family. He arranged for Pavel to discover his "body", actually that of one of his shadows, and later stabbed Pavel after it appeared to him that Pavel, by bringing back Jon, was attempting to revive the plot against Chronoron. Avel reappeared in the final battle at the Courts of Tumba, his silver arrows killing Jon. In the second set of novels, he himself is killed by Mark/Rinaldo as revenge for Jon's death. This results in Robert and Gérard declaring vendetta against Mark.
